name: Adolfström-Sjnulttjie raststuga
estimatedTime: 7-8 hours (STF); Naturkartan 8-10 hours for Adolfström-Sjnulttjie raststuga

difficulty.summary: No formal official difficulty grade found. STF calls the stage long but easy, mostly low-mountain terrain. Naturkartan describes a mostly easy path with many boardwalks, but wet back-mires, winter-route/quad-track crossings, a long ascent after Bádasjuhka and weather exposure on low fell. Field reports add mud, mosquitoes/bugs, poor visibility and water planning at Sjnulttjie.

routeType: mainline hiking stage with optional private Adolfström-Bäverholmen boat shortcut and a short spur to Sjnulttjie shelter

officialSources.name: STF Kungsleden Kvikkjokk-Ammarnäs route page
officialSources.evidence: Lists Stage/Etapp 7 as Adolfström-Sjnulttjie shelter, after Jäckvik-Adolfström and before Sjnulttjie shelter-Ammarnäs. Gives 23 km and 7-8 hours, camping accommodation, optional boat shortcut Adolfström-Bäverholmen shortening by 8 km, and a Tjålmejaure public-guidance warning.
officialSources.caveat: STF uses English 'Sjnulttjie shelter'; Naturkartan/Länsstyrelsen facility label is Raststuga Sjnulttjie.

officialSources.name: Naturkartan / Länsstyrelsen BD88 Adolfström-länsgränsen
officialSources.evidence: Official route record for Adolfström-länsgränsen, Kungsleden. Gives subdistance Adolfström-Sjnulttjie raststuga 23 km and 8-10 hours, Adolfström-Bäverholmen 8 km, route description via Iraft/Yraft, Bäverholmen, Bádasjuhka, boardwalks and Sjnulttjie, plus public Tjålmejaure guidance.
officialSources.caveat: Page covers broader Adolfström-county-boundary route, not only the section endpoint; the page still repeats an apparently expired Tjålmejaure hiker-access restriction and its linked overview map currently returns 404.

officialSources.name: Naturkartan Raststuga Sjnulttjie
officialSources.evidence: Official shelter page describes Sjnulttjie as a temporary rest shelter for 8 people with stove, firewood and latrine; overnighting/firewood only in emergencies; no mountain refuse collection. Google directions coordinate clue is about 66.2099821510769,16.3770011055576.
officialSources.caveat: Norwegian-language slug uses snultje, but page title is Sjnulttjie. Do not treat the rest shelter as ordinary lodging.

officialSources.name: Naturvårdsverket state trail WFS / Statliga leder
officialSources.evidence: Best official open geodata base for BD88/Kungsleden linework and official facilities. Section requires assembly: Adolfström handoff/service endpoint, BD88 mainline and Sjnulttjie shelter spur.
officialSources.caveat: The raw BD88/Naturkartan line is broader than the stage and stored in the opposite direction in some sources; section import needs clipping, reversing and adding the shelter spur.

officialSources.name: Lantmäteriet Sök ortnamn
officialSources.evidence: Confirms Sjnulttjie as Umesami place name in Arjeplog/Norrbotten and Adolfsström as official settlement/trakt spelling. Trail sources use Adolfström.
officialSources.caveat: Place-name centroids are not trail endpoint coordinates.

officialSources.name: Tjålmejaure protected-area and access-restriction source set
officialSources.evidence: Tjålmejaure remains a current Djur- och växtskyddsområde / bird-wildlife protection context. The specific 9 May-14 Aug hiker access restriction found in 25 FS 2016:23 was time-limited until 2019-08-14; NVR/Skyddad Natur did not expose an active Tjålmejaure access-ban subarea or renewal in 2026.
officialSources.confidence: high for protected-area status and apparent expiry of the hiker access ban; medium for final legal interpretation pending direct Länsstyrelsen confirmation
officialSources.caveat: Public Naturkartan/STF/Länsstyrelsen-facing pages still repeat the seasonal hiker guidance; retain as source contradiction/advisory until Länsstyrelsen confirms current status.

officialSources.name: OSM / Waymarked relation 18864497
officialSources.evidence: Non-official section geometry cross-check in official direction. Relation gives a clean Adolfström-to-Sjnulttjie mainline but omits the shelter spur; add OSM way 182824692 if using OSM topology.
officialSources.caveat: Use only as secondary topology/check unless project source policy chooses OSM-derived geometry.

commuteAccess.summary: Adolfström has road and sparse/demand-responsive bus access. Bäverholmen is an optional private-boat/service point along the route. Sjnulttjie has no direct road, bus or ferry access; practical exits are back north to Adolfström/Bäverholmen or onward south toward Rävfallsstugan/Ammarnäs.

waterSources.summary: Official/Naturkartan and field sources indicate water is generally available along much of the stage, especially along lakes, rivers and jokks. The important caveat is Sjnulttjie: do not model the shelter itself as a reliable water source.

records.description: Do not import Sjnulttjie as a reliable water source. Field reports note no obvious nearby running water and refilling about 1 km after Sjnulttjie on the next stage; users should carry water into the endpoint.

waterSources.treatmentNote: Treat/filter natural water. Recheck seasonal drought, high water, snowmelt and ice conditions close to travel.

campingAndFire.summary: STF lists camping accommodation for the stage and Naturkartan says there are good tent sites and plenty of water along the broader section. Bäverholmen and Adolfström have managed service/camping context. Sjnulttjie is a rest shelter, not normal lodging, and water is unreliable there. In Tjålmejaure context, do not import unrestricted camping/off-trail freedom because public pages still repeat seasonal stay-on-trail guidance even though the legal hiker access ban appears expired.

currentNotices.finding: No official section-specific closure/reroute/bridge notice found for Adolfström-Bäverholmen-Bádasjuhka-Sjnulttjie during rules lane.
Länsstyrelsen Norrbotten countywide mountain notice said spring warmth worsened snow/ice; trail checks stopped and ice/open-water crossings may be unsafe or impossible.
currentNotices.caveat: Winter/spring condition notice, not a summer closure.

currentNotices.finding: SMHI warning feed showed a mountain-wind warning for Norrbotten mountains ending 2026-04-30T18:00Z.
currentNotices.caveat: Live weather warning only; verify immediately before departure.

dogsReindeerHuntingFishing.finding: General Swedish dog supervision applies 1 Mar-20 Aug; Norrbotten/reindeer context requires dogs leashed or safely confined where reindeer are present and extra care around calving.

Norrbotten state-land small-game hunting rules are seasonal and permit-based. 2025/2026 rules included Tjålmejaur bird-protection-related restrictions and reindeer-related closures; recheck current hunting terms before public use.
Arjeplog 2026 fishing rules contain site-specific Tjålmejaure/bird-protection area limits. Do not present fishing as generally available without checking current permits and dates.

safetyNotes: Long day with sparse services after Bäverholmen and no direct exit at Sjnulttjie.
Wet back-mires, boardwalks, quad/winter-route crossings and weather exposure on low fell can slow travel despite easy official description.
Strong mosquitoes/bugs reported in summer, especially near water and around Sjnulttjie.
No emergency phone found on BD88/this section in facilities lane.
Natural water should be treated; carry water into Sjnulttjie because field reports indicate no nearby running water.

conditionReports.source: A Tog's Trek Adolfström to Rävfallet field report
findings: Adolfström-Bäverholmen boat was arranged via local service, not scheduled; 2020 price/operator details are stale and should not be imported as current.
Warns around Sjnulttjie bird sanctuary/restrictions and found no running water near Sjnulttjie shelter.
Notes Bäverholmen/Ammarnäs distance signs may reference a shorter non-official route, which matters for continuation south.

conditionReports.source: MyWanderfulLife Kungsleden Bäverholmen-Sjnulttjie / Sjnulttjie onward reports
findings: Used motorboat from Adolfström/Bäverholmen; price depended on group size.
Describes Bäverholmen services and severe mosquitoes approaching/at Sjnulttjie.
Sjnulttjie shelter had table/bench, fireplace, firewood and broom, but limited damp/stony camping; water refill was about 1 km after Sjnulttjie on next stage.

conditionReports.source: AllTrails Segment 19 reviews summarized by field-report lane
findings: Route-app segment around 22.9 km, 650 m gain and 6-6.5 h; reviews varied from moderate to poor conditions.
Some route-app camping/water claims are too broad because they conflict with Tjålmejaure public guidance and Sjnulttjie water caveats.
SOBO hiker reports mention rain, headwind and thick mist on tops after Adolfström, supporting weather/visibility caution.
Adolfström services are useful but opening status can be volatile.

sourceContradictions.details: Public Naturkartan/STF/Länsstyrelsen-facing guidance still presents a 9 May-14 Aug stay-on-Kungsleden/leashed-dog/no-leaving-trail rule. Targeted legal/map follow-up found that 25 FS 2016:23 was valid only until 2019-08-14, the 2018 Natura 2000 plan also describes a temporary-through-2019 ban, NVR foreskriftsomraden returns empty, and national access-ban WFS has no Tjålmejaure feature.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Do not import as active enforceable 2026 seasonal access rule or polygon. Keep narrative advisory/source contradiction and verify directly with Länsstyrelsen before normalized import.

lanes.summary: Confirmed official section label/order/distance/time, Naturkartan broader BD88 record, Sjnulttjie shelter, boat shortcut, place-name aliases and Tjålmejaure public guidance.
Compared WFS/BD88, Naturkartan, OSM/Waymarked and private GPX; recommended assembled geometry with Adolfström handoff gap and Sjnulttjie shelter spur.
Mapped Adolfström access/services, Yraft/Bäverholmen facilities, bridges, Bárasjuhka shelter/toilet, Sjnulttjie shelter/toilet and suppress/pending decisions.
Checked Adolfström bus/roadhead, Bäverholmen private boat, no direct Sjnulttjie access and onward Rävfallsstugan/Ammarnäs/Arjeplog context.
Collected dated field/route-app evidence for terrain, boat shortcut, services, bugs/weather, Sjnulttjie water and shelter/camping caveats.
Confirmed Tjålmejaure, Yrafdeltat, Laisdalen, fire/dog/hunting/fishing/current-notice context and found the import-sensitive Tjålmejaure legal-currentness contradiction.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Initial research was strong except for one import-affecting caveat: whether Tjålmejaure 9 May-14 Aug hiker access restriction remained legally active after 2019. Targeted follow-up required before section JSON.

lanes.summary: Concluded with high confidence that the 9 May-14 Aug hiker access restriction appears to have expired on 2019-08-14 and no active 2026 legal renewal was found.

Found broad current NVR 2012800 protected-area geometry but no current Tjålmejaure access-ban polygon, no Tjålmejaure feature in national access-ban WFS and no official marked rest-place coordinate map.
Recommended conservative advisory/source-contradiction handling rather than normalized enforceable seasonal rule or polygon unless Länsstyrelsen confirms current legal status.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Complete enough for research-ready candidate file. Treat Tjålmejaure as broad protected-area and public-guidance contradiction/advisory; do not import active seasonal hiker access restriction or polygon without direct Länsstyrelsen confirmation.

openQuestions: Before runtime import, ask/confirm with Länsstyrelsen Norrbotten whether any post-2019 Tjålmejaure hiker access restriction is legally active despite NVR and legal-source evidence.
Obtain any current official Tjålmejaure access-ban map/polygon and marked rest-place/camping exception coordinates if Länsstyrelsen says a restriction is active.
Confirm whether Sjnulttjie shelter/tent area is a marked allowed rest/camping place during any future seasonal restriction window.
Finalize geometry source policy and assemble official line: Adolfström endpoint-zone connector, BD88/Naturkartan mainline, Sjnulttjie junction and shelter spur.
Recheck Bäverholmen boat operator/contact/fare/low-water pickup and Bäverholmen service openings before public use.
Recheck Adolfström bus line 900/102 schedules, booking rules and pet/luggage constraints before public use.
Verify Sjnulttjie nearest reliable water source if water POIs are imported, and avoid treating the shelter itself as water.
Decide bridge/fireplace/rules-warning taxonomy for import, especially whether bridge POIs are supported.
Final selected-line GIS overlay needed for Yrafdeltat, Laisdalens fjällurskog, Tjålmejaure SPA/broad DVO and any Natura watercourse context.
